# Scenario tests

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen-docs.py from tests/*.txt. Don't edit by hand. -->

Each file in `tests/` is a script the dev harness plays against the running game, checking the
`[GLEVT]` log as it goes (see [Dev loop and harness](harness.md)). The description is the comment at the top of the file.

```powershell
./scripts/dev.ps1 test                         # run them all
./scripts/dev.ps1 test tests/teach-haul.txt    # just one
```

## Scenarios (38)

| Test | What it checks |
|---|---|
| `bonding` | A freshly tamed greyling is a stray with a name of its own; trust comes from pats (with a cooldown), food and company; at 100 it becomes a teachable greenling. |
| `chores` | With nothing to do, greenlings tidy loose things into the chest they belong in, and pick up simple chores by watching you (no coin). |
| `cook-job` | Two demonstrations make a two-step job: meat onto the cooking station, cooked meat back into the chest. Any meat the station takes will do, not just the one shown. |
| `death-drop` | A greenling that dies drops what it was holding, and its hammer. |
| `feeding` | Upkeep: hungry greenlings eat food left on the ground (never from your chests), and one can be taught to keep a feeding spot stocked. |
| `follow` | E on a trusting greenling: follow me / stay. Strays tag along for a bit after a treat. |
| `forage` | A curious greenling watching you pick berries runs off and picks some for you. |
| `games` | Greenlings play together: tag, and a huddle (standing in a ring, nattering). |
| `generalize-fire` | Show it one torch and it keeps every torch around topped up (lowest first). |
| `gift` | Greenlings bring you little presents and stare at you. |
| `hostility` | Wild greylings attack greenlings on sight (and the greenling fights back). |
| `lose-interest` | A watching greenling gives up when nothing is taught in time. |
| `mischief` | Idle greenlings misbehave: carry loose things off (never raid chests), run around. |
| `multi` | One demonstration teaches every greenling that is watching. |
| `needs` | Upkeep: greenlings eat food left lying about when hungry, and sleep in a nest at night (beds are shared out each night; nests also count as home for the "no nest" need). |
| `passive` | Greenlings leave animals alone (they used to attack boars), and greylings run from monsters. |
| `persist-1` | Part 1 of the persistence check (run part 2 after restarting the game): ./scripts/dev.ps1 test tests/persist-1.txt; ./scripts/dev.ps1 run; ./scripts/dev.ps1 test tests/persist-2.txt |
| `persist-2` | Part 2: after a restart the same greenling still knows its job (and its name) and carries on. |
| `personality` | Traits are rolled at taming; idle greenlings copy what you do; they watch each other's antics. |
| `repair-fetch` | Something needs fixing and there's a hammer in a chest nearby: a greenling fetches it and gets on with it. |
| `repair` | Give a greenling a hammer and it fixes worn pieces nearby now and then. |
| `reteach` | A working greenling can be taught a new job, and told to forget it. |
| `roles` | Greylings don't run machines; greydwarfs do. |
| `shaman-heal` | Shamans heal hurt tamed creatures nearby: greenlings, and your animals too. |
| `shaman-plant` | Only shamans plant. Show one a couple of carrots on a tilled strip and it fills the rest in neat rows, matching your spacing; a greyling watching the same lesson refuses it. It needs a cultivator, and fetches one from the chest once there is one. |
| `shaman-soothe` | Shamans help strays settle in: they go over and soothe one, and it trusts a little more. |
| `smash` | Greydwarfs break bushes for wood; brutes split logs. Neither touches standing trees. |
| `tame` | Real taming: coins on the ground, a calm greyling eats them and becomes a greenling. |
| `teach-beehive` | Collect honey from a beehive into a chest, including harvesting it again later. |
| `teach-cook-collect` | Take finished food off a cooking station and store it, before it burns. |
| `teach-cook` | Put raw meat from a chest onto a cooking station over a lit fire. |
| `teach-fermenter` | Load mead base into an empty fermenter. |
| `teach-fire` | Keep a fire fed with wood from a chest. |
| `teach-fuel` | Coal from a chest into a smelter's fuel slot. |
| `teach-ground` | Tidy up: loose wood on the ground goes into a chest. |
| `teach-haul` | Teach a greenling to haul wood from one chest to another. Run: ./scripts/dev.ps1 test tests/teach-haul.txt |
| `teach-pickable` | Harvest raspberry bushes around an area into a chest. |
| `teach-smelter` | Teach a greenling to carry copper ore from a chest into a smelter. Run: ./scripts/dev.ps1 test tests/teach-smelter.txt |

`persist-1` and `persist-2` are run around a game restart: `dev.ps1 test tests/persist-1.txt; dev.ps1 run; dev.ps1 test tests/persist-2.txt`.

## Shared preambles

Pulled into scenarios with `!include`.

| File | Does |
|---|---|
| `_look_field` | Visual check (not in the suite): let the shaman fill the strip at noon, then look down on it. |
| `_look_tools` | Visual check (not in the suite): tools in hand on each rig. |
| `_setup` | Clean slate: god + ghost, no auto-pickup, nothing left from earlier tests. |
| `_tamed` | A fresh greenling right in front of the player. |
| `_watching` | Tame a greenling and give it a coin: it is now watching the player. |
| `_watching_dwarf` | Tame a greydwarf (machines are greydwarf work) and give it a coin: it is now watching the player. |
